title: Task 5: ModelClient interface + Agent SDK adapter
design:
Risk isolation: the exact Claude Agent SDK TypeScript surface is uncertain at plan
time, so the design forces ALL of it into `agentSdkClient.ts`. Everything else in
the codebase depends only on `ModelClient` (`complete(input) => Promise<string>`),
which is stable. Unit tests use an in-test `FakeModelClient` (no SDK, no network),
so the suite is deterministic and offline. Acceptance #3's "round-trip" is a single
integration test using `describe.skipIf(!ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)` so it runs only when a
key is present and never blocks CI/offline dev — but proves the real wrapper when
run with a key. The adapter's message-extraction logic is the expected adaptation
point: the implementer must check the installed package's exported types and adjust
only that block; the contract, barrel, and tests are unaffected by such changes.
`model` is injected via constructor for later swappability (parent-epic design:
"swappable model later").
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run of model.test.ts and model.integration.test.ts shows 1 passed and 1 skipped when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is unset; npm run build exits 0.
notes: SYNTHESIS UPDATE 2026-05-17: Keep this task scoped to the initial Claude Agent SDK adapter, but avoid provider-specific leakage in the ModelClient contract. Follow-up provider/profile registry work is tracked separately so E0 can proceed without overloading this task.
close_reason: ModelClient + Agent SDK adapter implemented; spec compliant; quality-reviewed (cast fix applied a76d15d, error-semantics deferred to jmv)

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text:
Code review summary for `8644e9b..0a1d464`:

Assessment: Ready to merge

Critical:
- none

Important:
- agentSdkClient.ts:34 — `as { type?: string; result?: string }` widens away the full `SDKMessage` union. The SDK exports `SDKResultSuccess` / `SDKResultError` as named types; using them (with a narrow type-guard or a targeted intersection cast) would let the compiler catch future SDK breakage rather than silently accepting it. Correct at runtime due to the verified comment, but a type regression risk. Suggested fix: import `SDKResultSuccess` and narrow with `(m as SDKResultSuccess).type === 'result' && 'result' in m`, or import the union `SDKResultMessage` and switch on `subtype`.
- agentSdkClient.ts:38 — returns empty string `''` on error or empty stream, with no signal to callers. The ModelClient contract says `Promise<string>` with no error-path semantics defined. For production callers (E1 Orchestrator, E3 DM loop) a silent empty return will manifest as blank narration, not a thrown error. A follow-up (cck.8 or a new child task) should define whether `complete` throws on SDK error or returns a typed Result. Flag now, not critical for E0 merge.

Minor:
- agentSdkClient.ts:25 — prompt-flattening (`role: content` join) is untested offline. FakeModelClient in model.test.ts ignores prompt shape entirely. The flattening logic is the adapter's core responsibility and is only exercised in the gated integration test. A follow-up unit test with a mock query fn (vi.mock) would give offline coverage.
- model.integration.test.ts:15 — assertion is `out.trim().length > 0`, which passes even if the SDK returns an error string or unexpected content. A tighter assertion (e.g. `not.toBe('')` and checking for absence of error keywords) would improve confidence that the round-trip actually worked.
- packages/core/package.json — `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk` is listed under `dependencies` rather than a scoped optional dep. Consumers that only want the provider-neutral `ModelClient` interface still pull the SDK. Not a blocker for E0, but worth revisiting when the provider registry (cck.8) is built.

Follow-up:
- Define error-path semantics for ModelClient.complete (throw vs typed Result) before E1 Orchestrator integration — add as a sub-task under cck.8 or a new task.
- Add an offline unit test for agentSdkClient prompt-flattening using vi.mock on the SDK query function.
